propers.name: Collect
propers.text:
Infirmitatem nostram respice, omnipotens Deus: et, quia pondus propriae
actionis gravat, beati Ignatii Martyris tui atque Pontificis intercessio
gloriosa nos protegat. Per Dominum.

translations.caution:
A lay hand missal of the 1945 revision, printed about 1955-56, not an approved liturgical translation and never an altar book. Its Holy Week is the pre-1955 rite, its sanctoral is not the 1962 sanctoral, and its second and third orations are not those of 1962. It is carried only where a 1962 formulary is the same prayer, and nothing here may be used for recitation.

propers.name: Postcommunion
propers.text:
Refecti participatione muneris sacri, quaesumus, Domine Deus noster: ut,
cujus exsequimur cultum, intercedente beato Ignatio Martyre tuo atque
Pontifice, sentiamus effectum. Per Dominum nostrum Jesum Christum, Filium
tuum: Qui tecum vivit et regnat in unitate Spiritus Sancti Deus: per omnia
saecula saeculorum. R. Amen.
